raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows carry numeric region codes ('01' to '04') instead of region names. raw_region_map gives the mapping: 01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH. silver_customers uppercases them but never translates them, so gold_region_daily has wrong region groups.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code;"}}
